assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations, lightheadedness, and intermittent syncope suggestive of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and sick sinus syndrome.

Given the personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction, continuous ambulatory monitoring is indicated to detect arrhythmic events and guide anticoagulation and rate-control management.
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) is medically necessary.
The patient has documented paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I49.5).
The patient has documented sick sinus syndrome (I48.0).
